_comment: IMMUTABLE. The post-migration retrieval gate verdict, over UNIQUE check ids. Do not edit; a new verdict gets a new file.

runs.sourceOf: A, B, C, E, F, G, and D/paragraph-fallback-span

runs.note: Launched as --only D,E,F,G into a FRESH output path so nothing was carried and nothing could accumulate. Class D completed in 342s. The E/F stage then aborted on a defect in LCC's in-flight retrieve.ts — see evidence.efStageBlocked. G never started.
Direct re-measurement against judgment_chunks / judgment_paragraphs, bypassing retrieval. Re-establishes the span assertion, NOT the retrieval that selected the candidate.

evidence.duplicationCause: A check's tagged class is not the stage that produces it. spansFromResults() emits cls:'D' from inside the E/F stage (post-migration-cli.ts:503, called at :661) and classG emits paragraph-fallback-span as cls:'D' (:912). The resume logic carries forward every prior check whose CLASS was not re-run (:1574-1576), so the final --only A,B,E,F pass carried the 8 span-retrieval-hybrid entries forward AND re-emitted them from its E/F stage. Deterministic; accounts for all 8 duplicates exactly and for nothing else.
evidence.duplicatesWereIdentical: All 8 duplicated pairs were byte-identical in the accumulated artefact — same verdict, same detail, same offsets. No grade disagreed with itself.
evidence.killedDuplicateExonerated: The --only A,B process killed at ~08:1x UTC cannot have caused this: with only={A,B} it grades no D stage, and its carried set is a filter over the prior file, which cannot introduce a new copy. Two E/F stage executions are required; --only A,B is not one. This also answers NEW2's 0631 question about which process wrote the final file.
evidence.runIsolationNotProvableFromArtefact: The artefact carries no per-check run id or timestamp, the file is untracked in git, and no console log of the earlier runs survives. Isolation was therefore RE-ESTABLISHED by re-measurement rather than argued from the file.
evidence.onlyDWouldHaveBeenWrong: Re-running --only D alone would have DROPPED the 8 duplicated checks rather than re-grading them: they are emitted by the E/F stage, and the carry filter excludes prior checks whose class IS being re-run. The same class-vs-stage confusion, in the other direction. This is why the re-run was launched as D,E,F,G.
evidence.efStageBlocked: services/api/src/search/retrieve.ts exactCitation() throws PostgresError 42601 'syntax error at or near UNION' before reading a row: LIMIT on an un-parenthesised UNION branch is a parse error. Isolated 4 ways against the local cluster — un-parenthesised fails 42601 even with NO reference to lawmind_citation_keys; parenthesised fails only 42883 (function does not exist) and succeeds outright without the function. So migration 0052 will NOT fix it. This is LCC's uncommitted in-flight change, reported as bus 0638, NOT touched by NEW1, and NOT a migration defect: the accumulated E/F checks ran against retrieve.ts as it was before that edit.
evidence.spanRemeasurementMethod: exactSpan has TWO sources in retrieve.ts: the retrieved chunk (:796) and judgment_paragraphs via fillParagraphFallback (:897). A first pass checked only chunks and reported 3 of 8 as FAIL; all 3 are judgments holding ZERO chunks, so the paragraph table was their span source and a chunk-shaped question was the wrong question. Corrected to check both: 8 PASS, 0 FAIL. Recorded because the intermediate result looked like data loss and was not.
evidence.spanRemeasurementLimit: This re-measures the span assertion (full_text at that offset is still byte-identical to the stored chunk/paragraph text), NOT the hybrid retrieval that selected those candidates. The retrieval half was measured at 08:19:26Z and cannot be re-measured until the exactCitation defect is fixed. Stated rather than glossed.

notRerun.reason: Per founder directive: not duplicated, and not re-run for a reporting defect in D. A and B are ~3.5h of unindexable cite: scans; C is ~45m of live overruled reads. E/F/G were in the re-run's scope and were blocked by the exactCitation defect, not by anything about the migration.
notRerun.completeness: Checked against the fixtures, not assumed. A 11 = 1 bommai-exact + 5 neutral + 5 reporter from the 5 citationIdentity entries in fixtures/post-migration-probes.json, each carrying both a neutral and a reporter citation. B 2 = ambiguous + nonexistent. C 15 = 4 counts + 5 overruled + 5 live-read + 1 currentness-population. E 3, F 6, G 1, H 7.

crossCheck.note: Every re-measured check agreed with the accumulated artefact. A disagreement would have failed this build.

evidence.databaseState: LOCAL_DATABASE_URL 127.0.0.1:5432/lawmind, PostgreSQL 18.6, postmaster up since 2026-08-17T02:47:38Z — the SAME server instance that ran the accumulated gate. LCC applied migration 0053 between the runs (CREATE TABLE on an empty derived table, 0.47s); 0052 is deliberately NOT applied, so no retrieval hot path changed under either run.
evidence.fixLanded: summarise() now counts over unique cls+id (dedupeChecks, last write wins) and the CLI names every collapse out loud before printing totals. 46/46 harness unit tests pass; tsc --noEmit clean.
